purpose: Point-in-time opportunity and feature population; preserve no-signal, unavailable, missed and refused rows.

required_fields.instrument_revision: exact contract revision identity or NULL with reason
required_fields.reconstructed_available_at_utc: historical availability estimate, never actual receipt time
required_fields.state: actual policy state or explicit UNAVAILABLE/NOT_RUN/DATA_MISSING
required_fields.raw_input_refs: immutable source file and row identities
required_fields.feature_values_json: only computed observed values; unknowns remain null
required_fields.exact_action_ref: only when genuinely constructed from required inputs
required_fields.holdout_partition: development, calibration, reserved diagnostic or unknown exposure

instrument_contract: No row may claim live receipt, executable eligibility, fill or historical provider output from an archive download timestamp.
